# FhEmb API


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

> It’s architecture implements a pipeline of four classe: `Piece` →
> `Datasource` → `Embedding` → `Decomposition`, where `Piece` and
> `Datasource` are input providers (the `Piece` supplies metadata,
> `Datasource` supplies raw content), `Embedding` implements canonical
> signal objects with provenance and analysis methods, and multi‑scale
> transforms yielding `WDecomposition`, which enables inverse
> reconstruction back to a denoised `Embedding`.

``` raw
Piece (face_t, facebbox_t)
 └── Datasource (binheights_ts, percentiles_ts, features_ts)
      └── Embedding (feature × time per subject)
           └── Wdecomposition (bands → band-Embeddings)
                └── Embedding (reconstructed; loop back to Wdecomposition)
```
